item.title: Over 900 Forestry Corporations Suspected of Violations and Ineligibility... Government Requests Investigation into 78 Entities (산림법인 900여곳 위법·자격미달 의혹… 정부, 78곳 수사 의뢰)
item.description:
Over 900 Forestry Corporations Suspected of Violations and Ineligibility... Government Requests Investigation into 78 Entities (산림법인 900여곳 위법·자격미달 의혹… 정부, 78곳 수사 의뢰)

A government investigation has found that nearly half of the registered "forestry business corporations"—specialized companies authorized to conduct forest-related activities such as forest surveys, tree planting, maintenance, and logging—are suspected of failing to meet legal qualification requirements or engaging in illegal practices, including the lending of certification credentials. <<> On the 15th, the Government Joint Anti-Corruption Task Force under the Office for Government Policy Coordination announced the interim results of a "joint inspection on the status of forestry project implementation." Since May, the task force has been conducting a full review of 1,901 forestry corporations nationwide in collaboration with the Korea Forest Service. <<> According to the task force, on-site inspections have been completed for 1,412 of the 1,901 forestry corporations. The remaining 489 corporations were either closed, had changed their business locations, or had no corporate representatives available for inspection. <<> Among the 1,412 inspected corporations, approximately 900 were found to lack the minimum required capital, office space, or technical personnel stipulated by law. Even in cases where formal requirements appeared to be met, many instances were identified where the technical personnel listed as employees lived far from the forestry corporation or received abnormally low salaries, suggesting that actual employment relationships likely did not exist. <<> A significant number of technicians were also caught lending their certification credentials to help forestry corporations meet the technical personnel hiring requirements. It was revealed that 126 individuals had lent their certifications to 30 forestry corporations, and 39 individuals were found to be double-employed across 48 forestry corporations. <<> A representative of a forestry corporation in Boeun County, North Chungcheong Province, identified as A, was caught after assisting an acquaintance, B, and 10 other forest technicians in obtaining certifications and then borrowing their credentials to falsely claim they were employed by the corporation to maintain registration requirements. Meanwhile, C, who held a mid-level forest management technician certification, was caught after falsely presenting himself as simultaneously employed by four forestry corporations located in Uiseong County, Hadong County, Goseong County, and Gumi City. <<> The task force and the Korea Forest Service have referred these individuals to the police for investigation on charges of violating the Forest Technology Act's prohibition on certification lending, and have decided to revoke the relevant certifications. <<> The task force announced that it is conducting additional inspections on corporations not covered in this first round and those requiring supplementary review. It plans to complete the investigation by as early as next month and to revoke the corporate registrations and technical certifications of those found to have engaged in illegal activities. Furthermore, noting that some entities are canceling existing corporate registrations and attempting to register anew to evade inspection, the task force stated it would thoroughly verify new registration applications to prevent insufficient registrations. <<> The task force stated, "We will relentlessly track down and eradicate any attempts to unjustly and illegally seek profits, not only in forestry business corporations but across all government projects." (숲 조사와 나무 심기, 가꾸기, 벌채 등 숲과 관련된 사업을 할 수 있는 전문 업체인 ‘산림사업법인’으로 등록한 업체 절반 가까이가 법상 자격 요건에 미달하거나 자격증 명의 대여 등 위법 행위를 한 것으로 의심된다는 정부 조사 결과가 나왔다.)

item.title: Jeong Seong-ho: "A lot seems to need discussion" on ruling party's bill to abolish supplementary investigation powers (정성호, 與 보완수사권 폐지안에 “논의할 게 많아 보여”)
item.description:
Jeong Seong-ho: "A lot seems to need discussion" on ruling party's bill to abolish supplementary investigation powers (정성호, 與 보완수사권 폐지안에 “논의할 게 많아 보여”)

Minister of Justice Jeong Seong-ho expressed a cautious stance regarding the bill promoted by the Democratic Party of Korea to abolish prosecutors' supplementary investigation powers, stating that "there seems to be a lot to discuss." This was interpreted as his view that institutional mechanisms are needed to address the investigative vacuum and victim protection issues resulting from the abolition of supplementary investigation powers. (정성호 법무부 장관이 더불어민주당이 추진하는 검사의 보완수사권 폐지 법안에 대해 “논의될 게 많이 있어 보인다”며 신중한 입장을 밝혔다. 보완수사권 폐지로 인한 수사 공백과 피해자 보호 문제를 보완할 제도적 장치가 필요하다는 취지로 풀이됐다.)

Minister Jeong gave this response on the 15th while meeting with reporters before attending the plenary session of the National Assembly's Legislation and Judiciary Committee, when asked about his position on the amendment bill proposed by the Democratic Party's task force (TF) for revising the Criminal Procedure Act. (정 장관은 15일 국회 법제사법위원회 전체회의에 출석하기 전 취재진과 만나 민주당 형사소송법 개정 태스크포스(TF)가 발의한 개정안에 대한 입장을 묻는 질문에 이같이 답했다.)

In response to reporters' questions about specific concerns, he refrained from commenting, saying, "It is not appropriate for the minister to speak personally." However, Minister Jeong added, "Abolishing the supplementary investigation power could lead to side effects," and stated, "My consistent argument is that we need to create institutional mechanisms to ensure victim protection is not neglected." (그는 구체적으로 우려하는 대목이 무엇이냐는 취재진 질의에 대해서는 “장관이 개인적으로 이야기하는 것은 적절하지 않다”며 말을 아꼈다. 다만 정 장관은 “보완수사권을 폐지하면 그로 인한 부작용이 발생할 수 있다”며 “피해자 보호에 소홀함이 없도록 제도적인 장치를 만들어야 한다는 게 일관된 주장”이라고 말했다.)

The amendment to the Criminal Procedure Act proposed by the Democratic Party's TF on the 9th includes removing provisions that designate prosecutors as the main body of investigations and abolishing both prosecutors' direct investigation powers and supplementary investigation powers. Even if prosecutors determine that an investigation into a case forwarded by the police is insufficient, they cannot investigate directly but can only request supplementary investigation from the police. The police must, in principle, complete the requested investigation within one month. (민주당 TF가 지난 9일 발의한 형사소송법 개정안은 검사를 수사의 주체로 규정한 조항을 삭제하고, 검사의 직접수사권과 보완수사권도 폐지하는 내용을 담고 있다. 검사는 경찰이 송치한 사건의 수사가 미진하다고 판단하더라도 직접 수사하지 못하고 경찰에 보완수사를 요구할 수만 있다. 경찰은 원칙적으로 한 달 안에 요구받은 수사를 마쳐야 한다.)

It was reported that the Ministry of Justice attended the Legislative and Judiciary Committee's subcommittee on bill review on the morning of that day, expressed concerns about the plan to fully abolish supplementary investigation powers, and explained the necessity of a system for forwarding all cases investigated by the police to the prosecution in principle. The logic is that even if supplementary investigation powers are removed, a separate review system for the police's decision not to forward cases and their investigation process is necessary. (법무부는 이날 오전 개정안을 심사한 법사위 법안심사소위원회에 출석해 보완수사권을 전면 폐지하는 방안에 우려를 전달하고, 경찰이 수사한 사건을 원칙적으로 모두 검찰에 넘기는 전건송치제도의 필요성을 설명한 것으로 전해졌다. 보완수사권을 없애더라도 경찰의 불송치 결정과 수사 과정에 대한 별도의 점검 체계는 필요하다는 논리다.)

Regarding opinions within the Democratic Party to allow supplementary investigations only for certain crimes, Minister Jeong said, "In the National Assembly, the people's stance is most important," and added, "I believe they will thoroughly discuss to ensure there are no gaps in protecting citizens' fundamental human rights and victims." (정 장관은 민주당 내부에서 일부 범죄에 한해 보완수사를 허용하자는 의견이 나오는 데 대해서는 “국회는 국민의 입장이 가장 중요하다”며 “국민의 기본적 인권과 피해자 보호에 빠지는 부분이 없도록 철저히 논의해줄 것으로 생각한다”고 말했다.)

Differences of opinion are also emerging within the Democratic Party over the full abolition bill. On the 14th, 11 Democratic Party lawmakers, including Rep. Hong Ki-won, proposed a separate amendment that would exceptionally allow prosecutors' supplementary investigations for crimes targeting socially vulnerable groups, such as sexual violence, stalking, child and elder abuse, and some crimes affecting people's livelihoods. While the Democratic Party leadership maintains its stance of full abolition, internal discussions over the method of victim protection are expected to continue. (민주당에서는 전면 폐지안을 둘러싼 이견도 나타나고 있다. 홍기원 의원 등 민주당 의원 11명은 14일 성폭력·스토킹과 아동·노인 학대 등 사회적 약자를 대상으로 한 범죄와 일부 민생 범죄에 대해서는 검사의 보완수사를 예외적으로 허용하는 내용의 별도 개정안을 발의했다. 민주당 지도부는 전면 폐지 기조를 유지하고 있지만 피해자 보호 방식을 둘러싼 당내 논의는 이어질 것으로 보인다.)

The issue of supplementary investigation powers is a key point determining the allocation of authority between the Public Prosecution Office and the Serious Crimes Investigation Office, which are set to launch on October 2. The Public Prosecution Office will take over the role of prosecution and maintaining indictments from the existing prosecution service, while the Serious Crimes Investigation Office under the Ministry of the Interior and Safety will handle investigations of serious crimes. (보완수사권 문제는 오는 10월 2일 출범하는 공소청과 중대범죄수사청 체제의 권한 배분을 결정하는 핵심 쟁점이다. 공소청은 기존 검찰청을 대신해 기소와 공소 유지를 담당하고, 중대범죄 수사는 행정안전부 소속 중대범죄수사청이 맡게 된다.)

Regarding the possibility that prolonged discussions on supplementary investigation powers could delay the launch of the Public Prosecution Office, Minister Jeong responded, "I cannot speak hypothetically because I do not know the situation." When asked whether he would directly mention issues like the all-case forwarding system or the retention of supplementary investigation powers at the plenary session of the Legislation and Judiciary Committee, he drew a line, saying those matters are not on the agenda for review at today's meeting. (정 장관은 보완수사권 논의가 길어질 경우 공소청 출범이 늦어질 가능성에 대해서는 “상황을 모르기 때문에 가정적인 이야기는 할 수 없다”고 답했다. 법사위 전체회의에서 전건송치나 보완수사권 존치 문제를 직접 언급할지에 대해서도 이날 회의의 심사 대상 법안이 아니라며 선을 그었다.)

When asked whether concerns within the Ministry of Justice are ongoing, Minister Jeong said, "Just what's reported in the media," and added, "The government's basic position is already set." This was interpreted as reiterating his stance that, while following the government's policy to abolish supplementary investigation powers, specific amendments to the Criminal Procedure Act must ensure sufficient provisions for victim relief and control mechanisms between investigative agencies. <<>> (정 장관은 법무부 내부의 우려가 계속되고 있느냐는 질문에는 “언론에 나오는 정도”라며 “정부의 기본 입장은 이미 정해져 있다”고 말했다. 보완수사권 폐지라는 정부 방침을 따르되, 구체적인 형사소송법 개정 과정에서는 피해자 구제와 수사기관 간 통제 장치를 충분히 마련해야 한다는 입장을 거듭 강조한 것으로 풀이된다.)

item.title: Prosecution's supplementary investigation powers retained... People Power Party proposes 'Three Victim Protection Laws' (檢보완수사권 존치...국힘, ‘범죄 피해자 보호 3법’ 발의)
item.description:
Prosecution's supplementary investigation powers retained... People Power Party proposes 'Three Victim Protection Laws' (檢보완수사권 존치...국힘, ‘범죄 피해자 보호 3법’ 발의)

The People Power Party has proposed a revision to the Criminal Procedure Act as a party bill on the 15th, maintaining the current supplementary investigation powers of the prosecution, in response to the Democratic Party of Korea's push to amend the Criminal Procedure Act to abolish the prosecution's supplementary investigation rights. (국민의힘이 더불어민주당이 검찰의 보완 수사권 폐지를 골자로 한 형소법 개정을 강행하는 데 맞서 보완수사권을 현행대로 유지하는 내용의 형사소송법 개정안을 15일 당론으로 발의했다.)

On the afternoon of the same day, the People Power Party introduced three bills under the name of the 'Three Victim Protection Laws,' including the Criminal Procedure Act amendment with this content and amendments to the Serious Crimes Investigation Office and the Prosecution Office, postponing the launch of the Serious Crimes Investigation Office and the Prosecution Office from October this year to one year later. (국민의힘은 이날 오후 이같은 내용의 형사소송법 개정안과 중대범죄수사청(중수청) 및 공소청의 출범 시기를 올 10월에서 1년 연기하는 중수청·공소청 개정안 등 총 3개의 법안을 ‘범죄 피해자 보호 3법’이라는 이름으로 발의했다.)

The key point of the Criminal Procedure Act amendment proposed by the People Power Party is to maintain the prosecutor's supplementary investigation powers and specify the scope of investigations to crimes referred by the police, crimes referred by the Corruption Investigation Office for High-ranking Officials, and crimes related to investigative agency officials. Additionally, it is assessed to have significantly expanded the scope of cases that the police must refer to the prosecution to prevent the police from unilaterally closing cases. (이날 국민의힘이 발의한 형사소송법 개정안은 검사의 보완수사권을 유지하고 수사의 범위를 경찰이 송치한 범죄, 공수처 송부 범죄, 수사기관 공무원 관련 범죄로 명시하는 것이 핵심이다. 또 경찰이 독단적으로 사건을 종결하는 것을 막기 위해 경찰이 검찰로 송치해야 할 사건의 범위도 대폭 확대했다는 평가다.)

Gwak Gyu-taek, a lawmaker and chairman of the party's Legal Advisory Committee, met with reporters after submitting the bill and said, "For cases referred to the prosecution, prosecutors can not only request supplementary investigations but also conduct supplementary investigations themselves. While this does not restore the full referral system, it ensures that victims can receive sufficient rights relief, making it almost equivalent to full referral." (당 법률자문위원장인 곽규택 의원은 이날 법안을 제출하며 기자들과 만나 “검찰로 송치된 사건은 검사가 보완 수사 요구를 할 수 있을 뿐 아니라 직접 보완 수사를 할 수 있도록 했다”며 “이는 전건 송치제를 복원한 것은 아니지만 피해자들이 충분히 권리 구제를 받을 수 있도록 하는 것으로 전건 송치에 버금가는 것”이라고 했다.)

Regarding the amendments to the Serious Crimes Investigation Office and the Prosecution Office, he stated, "Since the revision of the Criminal Procedure Act has not been completed and preparations for the opening of the new agencies are insufficient, we are postponing the enforcement by one year to ensure thorough consideration for crime victims, with the opening scheduled for April 2 next year." (중수청법과 공소청법 개정안에 대해서는 “형소법 개정이 마무리되지 않았고 새로운 기관의 개청 준비도 미흡한 상태”라며 “범죄 피해자 고려에 만전을 기하도록 시행을 1년 연기해 내년 10월 2일 개청하는 내용”이라고 했다.)

item.title: Ruling Party Pushes Through 30-Day Extension of Second Special Counsel Probe in Judiciary Committee (‘종합특검 30일 연장안‘ 與 주도로 법사위 통과)
item.description:
Ruling Party Pushes Through 30-Day Extension of Second Special Counsel Probe in Judiciary Committee (‘종합특검 30일 연장안‘ 與 주도로 법사위 통과 )

The National Assembly’s Legislation and Judiciary Committee held a plenary session on the 15th and passed a revision to the Special Counsel Act, led by the Democratic Party of Korea, to extend the investigation period of the second special counsel probe by an additional 30 days. Lawmakers from the People Power Party boycotted the session in protest. (국회 법제사법위원회가 15일 전체회의를 열고 2차 종합특별검사의 수사 기간을 30일 추가로 연장하는 내용의 종합특검법 개정안을 더불어민주당 주도로 의결했다. 국민의힘 소속 법사위원들은 이에 항의하는 차원에서 전원 불참했다.)

If the revision passes the National Assembly’s plenary session, the investigation deadline of the special counsel, currently set to end on the 24th, will be extended to the 23rd of next month. The number of public officials that can be dispatched to the special counsel will increase from the current 130 to 150, and the Ministry of National Defense will be added to the list of agencies requested to send personnel. The revision also includes provisions to appoint lawyers with at least five years of legal experience as prosecutors to handle trials for cases indicted by the special counsel. (개정안이 국회 본회의를 통과하면 오는 24일 종료될 예정인 종합특검의 수사 기한은 다음 달 23일까지 늘어난다. 특검에 파견할 수 있는 공무원은 현행 130명에서 150명으로 확대되고, 파견 요청 대상 기관에는 국방부가 추가된다. 법조 경력 5년 이상인 변호사를 공소유지 변호사로 임명해 특검이 기소한 사건의 재판을 담당하도록 하는 내용도 담겼다.)

The revision also stipulates that acts by public officials who intentionally obstruct audits through dereliction of duty or abuse of authority will be included in the special counsel’s investigation scope. The aim is to explicitly include within the investigation’s purview suspicions that public officials unfairly interfered in preventing or delaying audits related to cases under investigation by the special counsel, or in reducing, distorting, or concealing audit results. Rather than creating a separate “obstruction of audit” crime, this adds conduct that could constitute abuse of authority or dereliction of duty under existing criminal law to the special counsel’s investigative targets. (개정안은 공무원이 직무유기나 직권남용 등의 방법으로 감사를 고의로 방해한 행위도 특검 수사 대상에 포함하도록 했다. 특검 수사 대상 사건과 관련한 감사를 막거나 지연하고, 감사 결과를 축소·왜곡·은폐하는 데 공무원이 부당하게 관여한 의혹을 수사 범위에 명시하려는 취지다. 별도의 ‘감사방해죄’를 새로 만드는 것이 아니라 기존 형법상 직권남용·직무유기 등에 해당할 수 있는 행위를 특검의 수사 대상으로 추가한 것이다.)

This provision appears to have been added with an eye on the case of suspected inadequate auditing by the Board of Audit and Inspection regarding the relocation of the presidential office and residence under the Yoon Suk Yeol administration, which the special counsel is investigating. The special counsel is probing whether illegal construction circumstances were downplayed or concealed in audit reports during the audit process, and whether senior audit officials improperly intervened in the matter. (해당 조항은 종합특검이 수사하고 있는 윤석열 정부 당시 대통령 집무실·관저 이전 관련 감사원의 부실 감사 의혹 사건을 염두에 두고 추가된 것으로 보인다. 특검은 감사 과정에서 불법 시공 정황 등이 감사보고서에서 축소되거나 은폐됐는지, 감사원 간부 등이 이에 부당하게 개입했는지를 수사하고 있다.)

The People Power Party strongly criticized the extension of the investigation period and the increase in personnel. The PPP pointed out that since the special counsel has already used both permissible extensions under current law, revising the law again just before the investigation concludes is effectively an admission that the probe has yielded insufficient results. They also argued that a special counsel, which should operate exceptionally and temporarily, could degenerate into a de facto permanent investigative body through repeated extensions. (국민의힘은 수사 기간 연장과 인력 증원을 강하게 비판했다. 국민의힘은 종합특검이 현행법에 따른 두 차례의 기간 연장을 이미 모두 사용한 만큼, 수사 종료를 앞두고 다시 법을 개정하는 것은 사실상 수사 성과가 부족했음을 스스로 인정하는 것이라고 지적했다. 또 예외적·한시적으로 운영돼야 할 특검이 반복적인 기간 연장을 통해 사실상 상설 수사기관으로 변질될 수 있다고 주장했다.)

People Power Party floor leader Jeong Jeom-sik also criticized the situation, noting that combining the activity periods of the three existing special counsel probes and the second special counsel probe would result in a prolonged investigation, asking, “Just how long will the investigation period be extended?” He also claimed that the special counsel is expanding its investigation targets and focusing on probes related to opposition politicians as the end of its investigation approaches, fueling controversy over its political neutrality. (정점식 국민의힘 원내대표도 기존 3대 특검과 2차 종합특검의 활동 기간을 합치면 수사가 장기간 이어지는 셈이라며 “도대체 언제까지 수사 기간을 연장할 것이냐”고 비판했다. 종합특검이 수사 종료를 앞두고 수사 대상을 확대하고 야당 정치인 관련 수사에 집중하면서 정치적 중립성 논란을 키우고 있다는 주장도 내놨다.)

From a legal perspective, concerns about due process have been raised regarding “investigation first, legislation later.” Deputy Minister of Justice Lee Jin-soo expressed the opinion during the committee’s bill review that if the revision is interpreted as seeking retroactive legal cover for cases the special counsel has already investigated or indicted that fall outside the current law’s scope, it could significantly violate due process. The committee’s expert adviser also pointed out the need to examine whether this amounts to investigating targets not stipulated in the existing law before subsequently bolstering the legal basis through legislation. (법률적 측면에서는 ‘선 수사·후 입법’에 대한 적법절차 논란이 제기됐다. 이진수 법무부 차관은 법사위 법안심사 과정에서 특검이 이미 수사하거나 기소한 사건이 현행법상 수사 범위를 벗어나는데도 법 개정으로 이를 사후 보완하는 것으로 해석될 경우 적법절차 위반 소지가 크다는 취지의 의견을 밝혔다. 법사위 전문위원도 기존 법에 규정되지 않은 대상을 먼저 수사한 뒤 입법으로 근거를 보완하는 것인지 따져볼 필요가 있다고 지적했다.)

Some within the legal profession have also raised concerns about the efficiency of the investigation relative to its outcomes and costs. Critics note that even with an additional 30 days, it might be difficult to fully uncover new suspicions given the imminent end of the investigation, and that increasing personnel is unreasonable at a time when prosecutors are already dispatched to various special counsel offices and joint investigation units, straining the workforce of local prosecution offices. (일부 법조계에서는 수사 성과와 비용 대비 효율성에 대한 우려도 나온다. 수사 종료를 앞둔 상황에서 30일을 추가로 확보하더라도 새로운 의혹을 충분히 규명하기 어려울 수 있고, 각종 특검과 합동수사본부에 검사들이 파견돼 일선 검찰청의 인력 부담이 큰 상황에서 인원을 추가로 늘리는 것은 무리라는 지적이다.)

The special counsel maintains that the suspicions regarding the audit of the presidential residence relocation are not a separate case but are related to existing investigation targets, sharing evidence with them. They explained that during search and seizure operations, they demonstrated that these matters fell within the investigation scope, and since courts issued related warrants, the investigation itself has a legal basis. (특검 측은 관저 이전 감사 의혹이 별개의 사건이 아니라 기존 특검 수사 대상과 증거를 공유하는 관련 사건에 해당한다는 입장이다. 압수수색 과정에서도 수사 대상에 포함된다는 점을 소명했고, 법원이 관련 영장을 발부한 만큼 수사 자체에 법적 근거가 있다는 설명이다.)

The revision must pass a plenary session of the National Assembly to be finalized. The Democratic Party plans to complete the plenary session process and subsequent procedures before the 24th, when the current investigation period ends. (개정안은 국회 본회의 의결을 거쳐야 최종 확정된다. 민주당은 현행 수사 기한이 끝나는 오는 24일 전까지 본회의 처리와 후속 절차를 마친다는 방침이다.)

item.title: US Armored Vehicles Land on South Korean Floating Bridge off Coast… Joint Amphibious Training Conducted (해안에 띄운 韓 부교 위로 美 장갑차가 상륙…연합 양륙 훈련 실시)
item.description:
US Armored Vehicles Land on South Korean Floating Bridge off Coast… Joint Amphibious Training Conducted (해안에 띄운 韓 부교 위로 美 장갑차가 상륙…연합 양륙 훈련 실시)

The ROK-U.S. Combined Forces Command (CFC) conducted its largest-ever joint logistics support exercise to rapidly supply equipment and supplies, such as tanks, to the battlefield in the event of a contingency on the Korean Peninsula. An amphibious landing exercise simulating a destroyed port was also held for the first time in nine years. (한미연합군사령부(연합사)가 한반도 유사시 전차 등 장비·물자를 전장에 빠르게 공급하는 연합 군수 지원 훈련을 역대 최대 규모로 실시했다. 항구가 파괴된 상황을 가정한 양륙 훈련도 9년 만에 처음 실시했다.)

The CFC announced on the 15th that it has been conducting the "2026 Combined Joint Sustainment Training (CJST)" from the 13th to the 16th in the areas of Pohang, North Gyeongsang Province, and Hongcheon, Gangwon Province. CJST is a training exercise to smoothly distribute personnel and military supplies across land, sea, and air battlefields in the event of a contingency on the Korean Peninsula. Hosted by the CFC and the Joint Chiefs of Staff, it began in 2017 and has been held every one to four years; this is the fifth iteration. This year's exercise is the largest ever, mobilizing a total of 4,400 personnel, including 2,400 from the South Korean Army, Navy, Air Force, and Marine Corps, and 2,000 from the U.S. military. (연합사는 지난 13일부터 오는 16일까지 경북 포항과 강원 홍천 일대에서 ‘2026 연합합동지속지원훈련(CJST)’을 실시하고 있다고 15일 밝혔다. CJST는 한반도 유사시 육·해·공 전장에 인원과 군수 물자를 원활하게 분배하는 훈련이다. 연합사 및 합동참모본부 주관으로 2017년부터 시작해 1~4년마다 시행해 왔으며 올해가 5번째다. 올해 훈련은 한국 육·해·공군 및 해병대 2400여 명, 미군 2000여 명 등 총 4400여 명이 동원된 역대 최대 규모다.)

The key training on this day was the Combined Joint Logistics Over-the-Shore (CJLOTS) exercise conducted on the coast of Pohang. It involves deploying equipment such as floating bridges, which serve as temporary ports, at sea and transporting supplies from there to land, assuming that existing ports have been destroyed in wartime or similar contingencies. (이날 핵심 훈련은 포항 해안에서 진행된 연합합동해안양륙군수지원(CJLOTS) 훈련이었다. 전시 등 유사시에 기존 항만이 파괴된 경우를 가정해, 해상에 임시 항만 역할을 하는 부교(浮橋) 등 장비를 띄우고 여기서 육지로 물자를 수송하는 내용이다.)

A reporter from this publication observed the joint CJLOTS training at Dogu-ri beach in Nam-gu, Pohang on the morning of this day. At the end of a U.S. military floating bridge extending several hundred meters from the sandy beach towards the sea, a U.S. support vessel unloaded two 7-ton medium tactical vehicles. The trucks then moved along the bridge and came ashore. On a separately installed South Korean military floating bridge, armored vehicles and container boxes carrying combat supplies were moved from transport ships to the bridge. Detection radars, jamming devices, and Vulcan air defense guns were installed along the coast to defend against enemy drone attacks. Fuel supplied from an offshore tanker was stored in fuel storage tanks on the shore. (본지 기자는 이날 오전 포항 남구 도구리에 있는 도구 해안에서 연합군의 CJLOTS 훈련을 참관했다. 모래 해안에서 바다를 향해 수백m 뻗어 있는 미군 부교 끝에 미 수송 지원선이 7t짜리 중형 전술 차량 두 대를 내려놓자, 트럭이 부교를 따라 이동해 육지로 올라왔다. 별도로 설치된 한국군 부교에서도 장갑차와 전투 물자가 들어 있는 컨테이너박스가 수송선에서 부교로 옮겨졌다. 해안가엔 적 드론 공격을 방어하기 위한 탐지 레이더, 재밍(jamming·전파 방해) 기기와 벌컨포가 설치돼 있었다. 해안의 유류 저장 탱크엔 해상의 유조선에서 공급된 유류가 저장돼 있었다.)

A South Korean military official stated, "The Navy's LOTS (Logistics Over-the-Shore) system, including floating bridges, transport ships, and coastal fuel support vessels, introduced for the first time last year, was fully utilized for the first time in this exercise," adding, "During the training, U.S. armored vehicles used South Korean bridges, and South Korean supplies were moved onto U.S. transport ships, maintaining a close combined training posture through cross-utilization of each other's facilities." (우리 군 관계자는 “해군이 작년 처음 도입한 부교와 수송선, 해안유류지원정 등 해안 양륙 군수 지원(LOTS) 체계가 이번 훈련에서 처음으로 본격 활용됐다”며 “훈련 기간 중 미군 장갑차가 한국군 부교를 이용하거나 한국 물자가 미군 수송선으로 이동하는 등 서로의 시설을 교차 활용하며 긴밀한 연합 훈련 태세를 유지했다”고 말했다.)

The supplies moved to land were then supported to the Marine Corps through the Combat Service Support Area (CSSA) within the Pohang 1st Marine Division training ground. Among the supplies moved to the CSSA was a 3D printer capable of making simple combat tools or parts. Subsequently, they were transported overland and by rail to the forward-deployed units through the Army's 7th Corps Area Distribution Center (ADC) at the Maebongsan training ground in Hongcheon, Gangwon Province. An ADC is an area where supplies necessary for ground forces are stored, distributed, and transferred for transportation. (이렇게 육지로 옮겨진 물자는 포항 해병대 1사단 훈련장 내 전투근무지원지역(CSSA)을 통해 해병대에 지원됐다. CSSA로 옮겨진 물자 가운데에는 간단한 전투 공구나 부품을 만들 수 있는 3D프린터도 포함돼 있었다. 이후 육로와 철도로 전환 수송해 강원도 홍천 매봉산 훈련장의 육군 7군단 지역분배소(ADC)를 통해 전방 부대까지 보급됐다. ADC란 지상군에 필요한 물자를 저장, 분배, 전환 수송하는 지역이다.)

In terms of air supply, an Aerial Port of Debarkation (ATSP) was established at the Pohang Naval Air Command airfield to train rapid resupply procedures. Port operations (SPO) training was also conducted at Pohang New Port to inspect wartime port logistics support capabilities. SPO is a military procedure for receiving and distributing incoming supplies and personnel from the sea within a port. (공중 보급 측면에선 포항 해군 항공사령부 비행장에 항공추진보급기지(ATSP)를 설치해 신속한 재보급 절차를 훈련했다. 또 포항 신항에서는 항만 운영(SPO) 훈련을 통해 전시 항만 군수 지원 능력도 점검했다. SPO란 해상으로부터 들어오는 물자와 병력을 항만에 수용하고 분배하는 군 절차다.)

During this CJST exercise, a "Combined Joint Medical Support Exercise" was also conducted in parallel, simulating a mass casualty situation. Emergency treatment and evacuation drills were held on the coast and inland, assuming a scenario with 110 patients. Various means of transport were mobilized, including the KUH-1M "Medion" medevac helicopter, C-130 aircraft, trains, and firefighting helicopters. (이번 CJST 훈련 기간 중엔 대규모 사상자 발생 상황을 상정한 ‘연합·합동 의무 지원 훈련’도 병행했다. 환자 110명이 발생한 상황을 가정해 해안과 내륙에서 응급처치 및 후송 훈련이 진행됐다. 한국군의 의무 후송 전용 헬기인 메디온(KUH-1M) 헬기를 비롯해 C-130 항공기, 철도, 소방 헬기까지 다양한 운송 수단이 동원됐다.)

Brigadier General Park Jin-won, CFC J-4 (Director of Logistics), said, "Through this ROK-U.S. CJST, we were able to maximize our ability to sustain support across all domains—ground, sea, and air." He added, "As sustainment capability guarantees victory in war, we will further strengthen the ROK-U.S. combined defense posture through realistic joint exercises in the future." (박진원 연합사 군수참모부장은 “이번 한미 CJST를 통해 지상·해상·공중을 통한 전 영역 지속 지원 능력을 극대화할 수 있었다”며 “지속 지원 능력은 전쟁의 승리를 보장하는 만큼 앞으로도 실전적인 연합 훈련을 통해 한미 연합 방위 태세를 더욱 굳건히 하겠다”고 말했다.)

U.S. Army Colonel Frederick Crist, Deputy CFC J-4, also stated, "We cannot guarantee that the port we need in a crisis will always be ready," and added, "By unloading U.S. military ship cargo for the first time through the ROK system, we have demonstrated practical interoperability." (프레더릭 크리스트 연합사 군수참모차장도 “위기 상황에서 우리가 필요로 하는 항구가 언제나 준비돼 있을 것이라 장담할 수 없다”며 “최초로 한국군 시스템을 통해 미군 함정의 화물을 하역함으로써 실질적인 상호 운용성을 보여줬다”고 했다.)

item.title: Lee Orders "Swiftly Prepare Complementary Measures" for 'Samsung Electronics-SK Hynix' Leveraged ETFs (李, ‘삼전닉스’ 레버리지 ETF에 “보완대책 신속히 마련하라”)
item.description:
Lee Orders "Swiftly Prepare Complementary Measures" for 'Samsung Electronics-SK Hynix' Leveraged ETFs (李, ‘삼전닉스’ 레버리지 ETF에 “보완대책 신속히 마련하라”)

President Lee Jae-myung recently instructed regarding the single-stock leveraged exchange-traded funds (ETFs) for Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix, which have been cited as factors amplifying recent stock market volatility, to "swiftly prepare complementary measures." (이재명 대통령이 최근 증시 변동성 확대 요인으로 꼽히는 삼성전자·SK하이닉스 단일 종목 레버리지 상장지수펀드(ETF)와 관련해 “보완 대책을 잘 신속하게 마련하라”고 지시했다.)

President Lee made this remark to Korea Exchange Chairman Jeong Eun-bo during a business report held at the Presidential Office on the morning of the 15th. President Lee also mentioned to Financial Supervisory Service (FSS) Governor Lee Chan-jin regarding leveraged ETFs, "It seems you’ve been taking quite a hit lately." In response, Governor Lee said, "As a market regulator, I bear responsibility, so I am accepting it willingly." Governor Lee had previously stated at a press briefing last month, regarding the criticism that single-stock leveraged ETFs are increasing stock market volatility and confusing investors, "I regret that I didn’t lie down and block (the introduction of the system)." <<> Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Economy and Finance Koo Yoon-cheol also stated on the 7th, "Since issues have been raised, we are discussing ways to supplement and minimize those problems." Additionally, Presidential Office Policy Chief Kim Yong-beom said on the 10th, "If any supplements are needed, the F4 (Market Situation Review Meeting, comprising the Ministry of Economy and Finance, Financial Services Commission, Bank of Korea, and FSS) will review and discuss them." <<> Financial authorities are reportedly requesting the financial investment industry to strengthen investor protection measures related to single-stock leveraged ETFs. It is said that they are considering raising barriers, such as increasing the baseline deposit from the current 10 million won or imposing investment limits. (이 대통령은 15일 오전 청와대에서 열린 업무 보고에서 정은보 한국거래소 이사장에게 이같이 말했다. 이 대통령은 이찬진 금융감독원장에게 레버리지ETF와 관련해 “최근 많이 당하고 계신 것 같던데”라고 언급하기도 했다. 이에 이 원장은 “시장 관리자로서 책임이 있어서 책임을 달게 받고 있다”고 답했다. 이 원장은 지난달 기자 간담회에서 단일 종목 레버리지 ETF가 증시 변동성을 키워 투자자들이 혼란스러워하고 있다는 지적과 관련해 “(제도 도입을) 드러누워서 막았어야 했나 후회한다”고 했었다.)

item.title: Shin Dong-wook Proposes 'Ahn Gyu-baek Prevention Act', Mandating Submission of Military Records for Confirmation Hearing Candidates (신동욱 ‘안규백 방지법’ 발의 “인사청문 대상자 ‘병적기록’ 제출 의무화”)
item.description:
Shin Dong-wook Proposes 'Ahn Gyu-baek Prevention Act', Mandating Submission of Military Records for Confirmation Hearing Candidates (신동욱 ‘안규백 방지법’ 발의 “인사청문 대상자 ‘병적기록’ 제출 의무화”)

People Power Party lawmaker Shin Dong-wook on the 15th proposed a revision to the 'Confirmation Hearing Act' as a lead sponsor, requiring public office candidates subject to parliamentary confirmation hearings to include a military record form in the documents they submit to the National Assembly. This is aimed at Defense Minister Ahn Gyu-baek, who is suspected of having been absent without leave during his service as a reservist and has refused to disclose his military record. (국민의힘 신동욱 의원은 15일 국회 인사청문 대상인 공직 후보자가 국회에 제출하는 서류에 병적기록표를 포함하도록 하는 ‘인사청문회법 개정안’을 대표로 발의했다. 방위병 복무 시절 ‘군무 이탈’을 했다는 의혹을 받고 있는 안규백 국방부 장관이 병적기록부를 공개하지 않는 것을 겨냥한 것이다.)

Currently, when the government submits a request for a confirmation hearing for a public office candidate to the National Assembly, it includes information on the candidate's occupation, education, career, military service declarations, and property declarations. However, these military service declarations only confirm the date of enlistment, discharge date, and unit of service, making it difficult to verify disciplinary history, etc. The core of the bill proposed by Rep. Shin is to supplement this by mandating the inclusion of the military record form. (현재 정부는 국회에 공직 후보자에 대한 인사청문요청안을 제출할 때 직업·학력·경력에 관한 사항, 병역신고사항, 재산신고사항 등을 첨부하고 있다. 하지만 이 병역신고사항만으로는 입영일과 전역일, 복무부대 정도만 확인할 수 있고 징계 이력 등을 검증하긴 어렵기 때문에 병적기록표를 포함해 보완해야 한다는 게 신 의원이 발의한 법안의 골자다.)

Rep. Shin stated, "The suspicions surrounding the Defense Minister of the Republic of Korea's desertion remain unresolved," and added, "Legislative supplementation is urgently needed to verify the eligibility for public office by checking whether the candidate properly fulfilled the sacred duty of national defense." (신 의원은 “대한민국 국방부 장관의 탈영 의혹이 여전히 풀리지 않고 있다”며 “공직 후보자가 신성한 국방의 의무를 제대로 이행했는지 공직 적격성을 검증할 수 있는 입법적 보완이 시급한 실정”이라고 했다.)

The suspicions of 'absence without leave' against Minister Ahn were first raised during a parliamentary confirmation hearing in July last year and have recently reignited. The allegations are that Minister Ahn, after being conscripted as a reservist in November 1983 and serving in the company at Daesan-myeon, Gochang-gun, North Jeolla Province, under the Army's 35th Division, unlawfully absented himself from duty for approximately seven months. (안 장관의 ‘군무이탈’ 의혹은 지난해 7월 국회 인사청문회에서 제기돼 최근 재점화했다. 안 장관이 1983년 11월 방위병으로 소집돼 육군 제35사단 전북 고창군 대산면 중대에서 복무하던 중 약 7개월간 위법적으로 군무를 이탈했다는 의혹이다.)

In response, Minister Ahn explained during the confirmation hearing, "It was a military administration error, where the period spent attending university was included." The Ministry of National Defense also stated on the 10th, "We will request a correction of the military record error after the minister's term ends." However, the Ministry said it would neither disclose the military record nor file a request for correction during the minister's term. (이에 대해 안 장관은 인사청문회 당시 “대학 다니던 기간이 산입된, 병무 행정 착오”라고 해명했다. 국방부도 지난 10일 “장관 임기가 끝나면 병적기록 오류에 대해 정정을 청구하겠다”고 했다. 다만 국방부는 병적기록을 공개하거나, 임기 중에 병적기록 정정 청구를 하지는 않겠다고 했다.)

Earlier, People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk said, "If (the desertion allegations) are true, Minister Ahn should not hold that position, and even the President, who appointed Minister Ahn and has said nothing about these allegations, should not remain in office." Floor Leader Jeong Jeom-sik also said at a general meeting of party lawmakers, "Minister Ahn's refusal to disclose his military record is a concealment of the truth and a deception of the public," and added, "If he continues to refuse disclosure, we will have no choice but to regard it as an admission of his own desertion and confinement suspicions and consider submitting an impeachment motion." (앞서 국민의힘 장동혁 대표는 “(탈영 의혹이) 사실이라면 안 장관은 그 자리에 있어선 안되고, 안 장관을 임명하고 이런 의혹에도 한 마디도 하지 않는 대통령까지도 그 자리에 있으면 안 된다”고 했다. 정점식 원내대표도 의원총회에서 “(안 장관의) 병적기록부 공개 거부는 진실을 은폐하고 국민을 기만하는 것”이라며 “공개를 끝내 거부한다면 본인의 탈영과 영창 의혹을 인정하는 것으로 간주하고 탄핵 소추안 제출을 검토할 수밖에 없다”고 했다.)

item.title: Yoo Si-min: "Lee's Choice Will End in Failure... The Democratic Party Must Not Be Dominated by the President" (유시민 “李 선택 실패로 끝날 것...민주당, 대통령 지배받으면 안 돼”)
item.description:
Yoo Si-min: "Lee's Choice Will End in Failure... The Democratic Party Must Not Be Dominated by the President" (유시민 “李 선택 실패로 끝날 것...민주당, 대통령 지배받으면 안 돼”)

Yoo Si-min, a prominent voice in the political sphere, stated, "President Lee Jae-myung does not want the separation of investigation and prosecution powers," adding, "President Lee is making a very dangerous choice that will fail." Following his recent remark that "supporters wanted an extension, but President Lee is pursuing a complete rebuild," he once again criticized the president's line of integration and pragmatism. (여권 내 대표적 스피커인 유시민 작가가 “이재명 대통령은 검찰 수사·기소 분리를 원하지 않고 있다”면서 “이 대통령은 매우 위험한 선택을 하고 있으며 실패할 것”이라고 말했다. “지지자들은 증축을 원했는데 이 대통령이 재건축을 하고 있다”던 최근 발언에 이어 이 대통령의 통합·실용 노선을 재차 비판한 것이다.)

Appearing on the YouTube channel "Maebul Show" on the 15th, Yoo said, "(President Lee's choice) will not only harm himself but also break the hearts of the citizens who elected him." Regarding the delay in passing the bill to abolish the prosecution's supplementary investigation powers, Yoo argued, "The reason judicial reform hasn't been achieved in over a year is that the president doesn't want the separation of investigation and prosecution. It's come to this because the president didn't want it, and there can be no other explanation." (유 작가는 15일 유튜브 ‘매불쇼’에 출연해 “(이 대통령의 선택은) 본인에게만 해로운 게 아니고 이 대통령을 당선시킨 시민들의 가슴을 아프게 만들 것”이라며 이같이 말했다. 유 작가는 검찰 보완수사권 폐지 법안 처리가 지연되는 데 대해 “검찰개혁이 1년 넘게 안 이뤄지는 이유는 대통령이 수사·기소 분리를 원하지 않기 때문”이라면서 “대통령이 (수사·기소 분리를) 원치 않았기 때문에 여기까지 온 거고 그거 말고는 다른 설명 방법이 있을 수 없다”고 했다.)

Yoo also commented on some Democratic Party lawmakers proposing a bill to exceptionally retain supplementary investigation powers, saying, "They're likely doing that because they know the president's thoughts. I believe the government didn't submit its own plan and shelved it because the president prevented it." He added, "The president might judge it's better to leave some investigative powers with the prosecution. But the presidential campaign pledge was for a complete separation of investigation and prosecution. If his judgment changed, he should have sought the public's understanding." (유 작가는 민주당 일부 의원이 보완수사권의 예외적 존치 법안을 발의한 데 대해서도 “대통령 생각을 알기 때문에 하는 일일 것”이라면서 “(정부가) 정부안을 안 내고 접은 것도 대통령이 못 내게 한 것으로 본다”고 했다. 이어 “대통령이 수사권 일부를 검찰에 남겨놓는 게 좋겠다는 판단을 할 수 있다”면서도 “대선 공약은 수사·기소 완전 분리였다. (판단이 바뀌었다면) 국민에게 양해를 구했어야 한다”고 했다.)

Yoo criticized President Lee for handling the supplementary investigation powers issue "in a Machiavellian manner." He said, "The president should have resolved it responsibly. Instead, he had the Minister of Justice do it, then the Prime Minister, and so on. It's like 'let subordinates take the blame,' which comes from Machiavelli's 'The Prince.'" Regarding the president's governance style, Yoo said, "I won't say it's the wrong path, but it's a very dangerous choice for both himself and society. I believe that choice will end in failure." (유 작가는 이 대통령이 보완수사권 문제를 “마키아벨리적으로 처리했다”고 비판했다. 유 작가는 “(대통령) 본인이 책임감 있게 풀었어야 한다. (그런데) 법무부 장관 시키고, 총리 시키고, 그렇게 해왔다”면서 “‘욕 먹을 일은 밑 사람 시켜라‘, (마키아벨리의) 군주론에 나오는 것”이라고 했다. 대통령의 국정 운영 방식에 대해선 “잘못된 길이라고는 안 하겠다”면서도 “본인에게도, 사회에도 매우 위험한 선택이다. 저는 그 선택이 실패로 끝날 거로 본다”고 했다.)

Yoo also criticized the president for promoting so-called "Lee's picks" in key elections, saying, "The president is trying to place his preferred people in all key decision-making positions." He remarked, "In the Seoul mayoral election, the Democratic Party's primary was made unfair. The president backed Jung Won-oh, didn't he? In the Gyeonggi governor primary, a candidate touted himself as 'Lee's pick,' and the Blue House took no action." He added, "The party leader was also a 'Lee's pick.' They didn't explicitly say 'Jung Cheong-rae, don't run,' but they elevated Prime Minister Kim Min-seok beyond mere words of encouragement." He concluded, "This isn't a legal issue, but it shouldn't be done politically." (그는 이 대통령이 주요 선거 국면마다 이른바 ‘명픽’ 후보를 띄운 데 대해서도 “대통령이 모든 주요 의사결정권을 가진 위치에 자기가 원하는 사람을 넣으려 하고 있다”고 비판했다. 유 작가는 “서울시장 선거에서 민주당 후보 경선을 불공정하게 만들었다. 대통령이 정원오를 띄웠지 않느냐”면서 “경기지사 경선에서도 어떤 후보가 ‘명픽’이라며 자처했는데 청와대에서 아무 조치를 안 했다”고 했다. 또 “당대표도 ‘명픽’을 넣은 것”이라면서 “‘정청래 나오지 마’라고 안 했을 뿐 (김민석) 국무총리를 덕담 차원 넘어 띄우는 작업을 했다”고 했다. 그러면서 “이런 건 법적 문제가 아니고 정치적으로 하면 안 된다”고 했다.)

Yoo also stated, "The Democratic Party must not be subjected to the president's 'dominance.'" He explained, "The moment the Democratic Party accepts dominance by a president with power, the party begins to disintegrate. If the Democratic Party loses its identity and collapses, there is no tomorrow. That's why I believe President Lee's vision is dangerous and likely to fail." (유 작가는 “민주당이 대통령의 ‘지배’를 받으면 안 된다”고도 했다. 그는 “민주당이 권력 가진 대통령의 지배를 받아들이는 순간 그 당은 해체가 시작되는 것”이라면서 “민주당이 정체성을 잃고 해체되면 내일은 없다. 이 대통령의 구상이 위험하고 실패할 가능성이 많다고 생각하는 것이 그것 때문”이라고 했다.)

Last month, on Kim Eo-joon's YouTube channel, Yoo had also criticized President Lee, saying, "President Lee's supporters wanted an extension, but he is mobilizing demolition crews to tear everything down and rebuild." (유 작가는 지난달 말 김어준씨 유튜브에서도 “이 대통령 지지층이 원하는 것은 증축인데 대통령은 철거 용역을 동원해 다 허물고 재건축을 하려고 한다”고 이 대통령을 비판한 바 있다.)

item.title: President Lee Holds Kong-guksu Lunch with Blue House Staff for Chobok, Surprise Press Conference Also Held (李대통령, 초복 맞아 靑직원들과 콩국수 오찬…깜짝 기자간담회도)
item.description:
President Lee Holds Kong-guksu Lunch with Blue House Staff for Chobok, Surprise Press Conference Also Held (李대통령, 초복 맞아 靑직원들과 콩국수 오찬…깜짝 기자간담회도)

President Lee Jae-myung shared a "kong-guksu lunch" with staff at the Blue House cafeteria on the 15th to mark Chobok. After the lunch, he made a surprise visit to the Chunchugwan press room, where Blue House correspondents are stationed, and held a Q&A session for over an hour. <<> Blue House Senior Spokesperson Kang Yu-jung reported that eight staff members attended the lunch, including employees from heavy-duty departments such as the National Crisis Management Center, the Office of the Senior Secretary for Autonomy Development, and the Office of the Senior Secretary for Personnel, as well as outstanding staff who suggested policies for the Blue House. The menu for Chobok featured kong-guksu made with Korean wheat and Korean soybeans, along with baechu-jeon (cabbage pancakes), yeolmu-kimchi (young radish kimchi), and watermelon. <<> President Lee said via X (formerly Twitter) that day, "Thinking of our Blue House family, who silently fulfill their duties in their respective positions amidst various challenges big and small, I feel both sorry and reassured. I will do my best so that you can feel a full sense of pride and fulfillment in working at the Blue House, even though your work is busy and demanding." <<> After finishing the lunch, President Lee visited Chunchugwan without prior notice and held an informal meeting with Blue House reporters. During the one-hour-and-ten-minute session in Chunchugwan, the president discussed various national affairs with the reporters, holding a free Q&A session. (이재명 대통령이 15일 초복을 맞아 청와대 구내식당에서 직원들과 ‘콩국수 오찬’을 함께 했다. 오찬 후엔 청와대 출입기자들이 있는 춘추관에 깜짝 방문해 1시간 넘게 질의응답 시간을 가졌다.)

item.title: "Allies That Build Airports and Expand Welfare While Relying on U.S. Defense Must Realize the World Has Changed" (“美방어 의존하면서 공항 짓고, 복지 증진… 동맹, 세상 달라진 것 알아야”)
item.description:
"Allies That Build Airports and Expand Welfare While Relying on U.S. Defense Must Realize the World Has Changed" (“美방어 의존하면서 공항 짓고, 복지 증진… 동맹, 세상 달라진 것 알아야”)

Former U.S. Secretary of State Condoleezza Rice said on the 14th, "Allies who depend on U.S. defense while building great airports and constructing social welfare systems don't fully understand what's happening inside the United States." She added, "The U.S. is tired of shouldering the military burden alone. The world has changed, and (allied nations) must acknowledge that." Rice, the first female secretary of state under the George W. Bush administration, known as a hardliner on North Korea and nicknamed the "Iron Lady" in South Korea, made these remarks at the Aspen Security Forum (ASF) opening in Aspen, Colorado, stating, "I strongly support transatlantic and Asia-Pacific alliances, but the world has changed." (콘돌리자 라이스 전 국무장관은 14일 “미국의 방어에 의존하면서 훌륭한 공항을 짓고, 사회 복지 시스템을 건설하는 동맹이 미국 내 무슨 일이 벌어지고 있는지 제대로 이해하지 못하고 있다”며 “미국은 이제 홀로 군사적 부담을 짊어지는 데 지쳤다. 세상이 달라졌고 (동맹국도) 그 사실을 인정해야 한다”고 했다. 부시 정부에서 사상 첫 여성 장관을 지냈고, 대북 강경파이자 ‘철의 여인’이란 별명으로 국내에도 친숙한 라이스는 이날 콜로라도주(州) 애스펀에서 개막한 ‘애스펀안보포럼(ASF)’에 참석해 “대서양, 아시아·태평양 동맹을 강력히 지지하지만 세상이 달라졌다”며 이같이 밝혔다.)

Former Defense Secretary Mark Esper, who served during Trump's first term, also noted, "Trump accurately captured the voices of people who say, 'We're really fed up' with issues like national debt, student loans, and the cost of living." He added, "If other countries remain solely focused on their own welfare while endlessly expecting the status quo to continue, we cannot keep supporting global security." President Donald Trump, after returning to power, pressured NATO (North Atlantic Treaty Organization) members to increase defense spending to 5% of their GDP, and Esper recalled that former President Barack Obama also emphasized the need to meet minimum standards and used the term "free riders" at the 2014 NATO summit. (트럼프 1기 때 국방장관을 지낸 마크 에스퍼도 “트럼프는 국가 부채, 학자금 대출, 생활비 부담 등으로 ‘이젠 정말 지긋지긋하다’는 국민들의 목소리를 제대로 포착한 것”이라며 “다른 나라들이 자국 복지 증진에만 몰두하면서 현재 상황이 계속되기를 끝없이 기대하면 우리가 계속해서 세계 안보를 지원해 줄 수는 없다”고 했다. 도널드 트럼프 대통령은 재집권 후 나토(NATO·북대서양조약기구) 회원국을 상대로 국방비를 국내총생산(GDP)의 5%까지 늘릴 것을 압박했는데, 에스퍼는 버락 오바마 전 대통령 역시 2014년 나토 회의 때 최저 기준 준수를 강조하며 ‘무임승차자’란 표현을 썼다고 했다.)

The rejection and criticism from Europe of the U.S.-led military operations against Iran, initiated by Trump, also came under scrutiny. Rice stated, "I love our allies, but it's not wise to say 'this isn't our war' while the U.S. is fighting." She argued, "Even if you don't participate in the war, you shouldn't try to hinder the effort; rather, you should support it." Rice expressed concern that some leaders' claims of "we can do it without the U.S." could fuel isolationists in the U.S. who advocate for disengaging from foreign affairs. Esper also criticized Spain, Italy, and others for refusing to use U.S. military bases, saying, "We only asked to use our bases, and it was really foolish." (트럼프가 시작한 대(對)이란 군사 작전 당시 유럽이 파병 요청을 거부하는 것을 넘어 이를 비판한 것도 도마 위에 올랐다. 라이스는 “동맹을 사랑하지만 미국이 싸우고 있는 상황에서 ‘이건 우리의 전쟁이 아니다’라고 말하는 건 현명한 일이 아니다”라고 했다. “설령 전쟁에 참여하지 않더라도 노력을 방해하려 해서는 안 되며 오히려 힘을 실어줘야 한다”는 것이다. 라이스는 ‘미국 없이도 우리가 해낼 수 있다’는 일부 정상의 주장이 대외 문제에서 손을 뗄 것을 주장해 온 미국 내 고립주의자들에 좋은 먹이감이 될 수 있다고 우려했다. 에스퍼 역시 스페인·이탈리아 등이 미군 기지 사용을 거부한 것을 언급하며 “단지 우리의 기지를 사용해달라고 요청했을 뿐인데 정말 어리석었다”고 비판했다.)

The Aspen Security Forum, which opened today, continues for four days until the 17th, with around 1,000 global opinion leaders in attendance. The forum stems from the Aspen Strategy Group (ASG), a bipartisan foreign policy and security discussion group founded by Harvard professor Joseph Nye, a former senior Democratic official and advocate of "soft power," and Brent Scowcroft, a former National Security Advisor under a Republican administration, who joined forces. The group started its public forum in 2010. In his opening remarks, former U.S. Ambassador to China Nicholas Burns, the forum's co-chair, quoted Nye, saying, "We all come here with strong opinions and will express them, but if we listen to others, we can learn something, and it's okay to change our minds." Unlike Rice and Esper, Burns said, "Without alliances like NATO, where would the U.S. be today?" (이날 개막한 애스펀안보포럼은 전 세계 오피니언 리더 약 1000명이 참석한 가운데, 17일까지 나흘 동안 계속된다. 1984년 민주당 정부 고위직을 지냈고 ‘소프트 파워’를 주창한 조셉 나이 하버드대 교수, 보수 정부에서 국가안보보좌관을 지낸 브렌트 스코크로프트가 의기투합해 초당적 외교·안보 토론 모임인 ‘애스펀전략그룹(ASG)’을 만들었고 2010년부터 공개 행사 성격의 포럼을 시작했다. 포럼 공동 의장으로 있는 니컬러스 번스 전 주중 대사는 개회사에서 “우리 모두 확고한 의견을 갖고 이곳에 왔고 그에 따라 의견을 개진하겠지만, 다른 사람의 말을 경청하면 무언가를 배울 수 있으며 생각을 바꾸는 것도 괜찮다”는 나이의 말을 인용했다. 라이스·에스퍼와 달리 번스는 “나토 같은 동맹이 없었다면 미국이 지금 어디 있었겠느냐”라고 했다.)

()

◇ ☞Aspen Institute (◇ ☞애스펀연구소(Aspen Institute))

The Aspen Institute is a nonprofit organization founded in 1949 in Aspen, Colorado, by American businessman Walter Paepcke. Inspired by Aspen's natural beauty, Paepcke, a Chicago native, conceived the idea of a gathering where global leaders could escape daily routines and engage in dialogue. Its mission is "to address the most important challenges facing the U.S. and the world through dialogue and leadership." It aims to serve as a nonpartisan convener, stepping back from political divides to bring together diverse participants for discussion. With over 30 independent programs covering fields like economics, education, and the environment, it has hosted the annual Aspen Security Forum since 2010, where global foreign policy and security experts discuss domestic and international issues. (미국의 사업가인 월터 펩키가 1949년 콜로라도주 애스펀에 설립한 비영리단체다. 시카고 출신으로 애스펀의 자연경관에 감동한 펩키가 세계의 리더들이 일상에서 벗어나 토론을 하는 아이디어를 구상한 것에서 비롯됐다. “대화와 리더십을 통해 미국과 전 세계가 직면한 가장 중요한 도전 과제들을 해결하겠다”는 것이 운영 취지다. 정치 구도에서 한 발짝 물러나 다양한 사람이 모여서 토론하도록 주선하는 초당적 주관자를 지향한다. 경제·교육·환경 등 30여 분야에서 각 프로그램이 독립적으로 운영되고 있는데, 2010년부터는 매년 전 세계 외교·안보 전문가들이 국내외 문제를 논의하는 ‘애스펀안보포럼’을 개최하고 있다.)

item.title: World Heritage Committee Tells Japan, Which Overlooks ‘Forced Labor of Koreans,’ to “Address the Full History” (세계유산위, ‘조선인 강제노동’ 외면 日에 “전체 역사 다뤄야”)
item.description:
World Heritage Committee Tells Japan, Which Overlooks ‘Forced Labor of Koreans,’ to “Address the Full History” (세계유산위, ‘조선인 강제노동’ 외면 日에 “전체 역사 다뤄야”)

The UNESCO World Heritage Committee recommended to Japan on the 15th that it must improve as the Japanese government has failed to properly disclose the fact that forced labor of Koreans occurred at the Sado Island Gold Mines. This recommendation calls for Japan to faithfully fulfill the promises it made when it inscribed the Sado Gold Mines as a World Heritage site in 2024. This recommendation is seen as bolstering the South Korean government's stance. (일본 정부가 사도광산에서 조선인 강제 노동이 이뤄진 사실을 제대로 알리지 않아 개선해야 한다고 유네스코 세계유산위원회가 15일 일본에 권고했다. 일본이 2024년 사도광산을 세계유산으로 등재할 당시 한 약속을 제대로 이행하라는 것이다. 이번 권고는 한국 정부의 입장에 힘을 실어준 것으로 평가된다.)

The World Heritage Committee conveyed this recommendation in a draft decision circulated to member states, based on its evaluation of the conservation status report (SOC) submitted by Japan regarding the Sado Gold Mines. The draft decision assessed that while Japan has made “some progress” in implementing the World Heritage Committee's recommendation to establish an interpretation and exhibition strategy reflecting the site’s “full history,” this progress is insufficient. (세계유산위는 이날 일본이 제출한 사도광산 보존현황보고서(SOC)를 평가한 결과 이같이 권고했다고 회원국에 회람한 결정문안에서 밝혔다. 결정문안은 사도광산의 ‘전체 역사’를 반영하는 해석·전시 전략을 수립하라는 세계유산위의 권고를 이행하는 데 있어서 일본 측의 “일부 진전”이 있었으나 충분하지 않다고 평가했다.)

The World Heritage Committee recommended that Japan “comprehensively address the full history of the mine over the entire period of its operation at the site level, and closely consult with the relevant State Parties to improve the interpretation and exhibition strategy and facilities at the site level.” A foreign ministry official explained that “full history” includes the history of Koreans being forced to labor in the mines by Japan during the Japanese colonial period. (세계유산위는 “광산 개발 모든 기간에 걸쳐 전체 역사를 현장 차원에서 포괄적으로 다루고, 현장 차원에서 해석·전시 전략 및 시설을 개선하기 위해 당사국들과 긴밀히 협의하라”고 권고했다. 여기서 ‘전체 역사’란 일제강점기 조선인이 일본에 의해 광산에서 강제로 노역한 역사를 포함한다고 외교부 당국자는 설명했다.)

While acknowledging the additional measures Japan has taken so far to implement the recommendation, the World Heritage Committee requested that Japan more clearly explain how its interpretation and exhibition strategy and facilities comprehensively cover the full history of the Sado Gold Mines and regularly report the relevant progress to the World Heritage Committee. (세계유산위는 일본이 권고 이행을 위해 그간 취한 추가 조치를 인정하면서도 일본의 해석·전시 전략과 시설이 어떻게 사도광산의 전체 역사를 포괄적으로 다루는지 더 명확히 설명하고, 관련 진전 사항을 세계유산위에 정기적으로 보고하라고 요청했다.)

The World Heritage Committee has asked Japan to submit a report on the implementation of this recommendation by December 1, 2027, and plans to review that implementation report at the 50th session of the World Heritage Committee to be held in 2028. (세계유산위는 일본에 이번 권고에 대한 이행 보고서를 2027년 12월 1일까지 제출하라고 했으며, 그 이행 보고서를 2028년에 열리는 제50차 세계유산위에서 검토할 계획이다.)

Meanwhile, the South Korean government has conveyed its position this year through two rounds of director-general-level bilateral consultations with Japan that the coercive nature of the labor involving Koreans in the interpretation and exhibition of the Sado Gold Mines must be expressed more clearly. It is known that this position has also been consistently explained to UNESCO. (그간 우리 정부는 일본에 사도광산 해석과 전시에 있어서 한국인이 참여한 노동의 강제성을 더 분명하게 표현해야 한다는 입장을 올해 두 차례의 한·일 국장급 대면 협의 등을 통해 전달했다. 이를 유네스코에도 지속해서 설명한 것으로 알려졌다.)

A foreign ministry official stated, “We see this as a reflection of our consistent position, given that Japan’s implementation of the related recommendations is insufficient,” and added, “We will continue to make necessary efforts while closely consulting with the UNESCO Secretariat and relevant countries to ensure that Japan faithfully implements the World Heritage Committee's decision and the promises made at the time of inscription.” (외교부 당국자는 “일본 측의 관련 권고 이행이 충분하지 않은 상황에서 우리 측의 일관된 입장이 반영된 것으로 본다”면서 “앞으로도 일본 측이 세계유산위원회 결정과 등재 당시 약속을 충실히 이행하도록 유네스코 사무국 및 관계국과 긴밀히 협의하면서 필요한 노력을 지속할 예정”이라고 말했다.)

This draft decision will be discussed as an agenda item at the 48th session of the World Heritage Committee taking place in Busan between the 20th and 23rd. It is expected to be adopted by consensus if there is no disagreement among member states. However, it remains uncertain how faithfully Japan will follow the recommendation, as there are no clear penalties for non-compliance. (이번 결정문안은 부산에서 열리는 제48차 세계유산위에서 20∼23일 사이 안건으로 논의되며, 위원국 간 이견이 없으면 합의로 채택될 전망이다. 다만 일본이 권고를 얼마나 따를지는 미지수다. 권고를 따르지 않는 데 대한 불이익이 분명하지 않기 때문이다.)

Japan has taken some limited measures. A foreign ministry official explained that while there were criticisms that access to facilities used by Korean workers at the Sado Gold Mines, such as dormitory sites or communal kitchens, was not easy, Japan installed about ten related signposts at the site in the first half of this year. (일본도 일부 제한적인 조치는 하고 있다. 사도광산은 기숙사 터나 공동 취사장 등 한국인 노동자가 사용한 시설을 찾아가기 쉽지 않다는 지적이 있었는데, 올해 상반기 일본은 현장에 관련 이정표 10여 개를 설치했다고 외교부 당국자는 설명했다.)

The Sado Gold Mines, once famous for gold, were primarily used as mines to secure war materials as the Pacific War intensified. During this period, colonial Koreans were forcibly mobilized, and it is known that 1,519 Koreans toiled at the Sado Gold Mines from 1940 to 1945. (금광으로 유명했던 사도광산은 태평양전쟁이 본격화하면서 전쟁 물자를 확보하는 광산으로 주로 이용됐다. 이때 식민지 조선인들이 강제 동원됐고, 1940∼1945년 사도광산에서 노역한 조선인은 1519명으로 알려졌다.)

The inscription of the Sado Gold Mines as a World Heritage site was decided at the 46th session of the World Heritage Committee held in New Delhi, India, in July 2024. Ahead of the inscription, the South Korean government demanded that the site reflect its “full history,” including the forced labor of Koreans, and Japan accepted this, but it has not been properly reflected to date. (사도광산은 2024년 7월 인도 뉴델리에서 열린 제46차 세계유산위에서 등재가 결정됐다. 등재를 앞두고 한국 정부는 사도광산에 조선인 강제 노동을 포함한 ‘전체 역사’를 반영해야 한다고 요구했고, 일본도 이를 수용했지만, 현재까지 제대로 반영되지 않고 있다.)

item.title: Jang Dong-hyuk heads to Gwangju after Incheon and Busan… Kwon Young-se “No one in our party knows what he’s doing” (인천·부산 이어 광주로 간 장동혁…권영세 “뭐하는지 우리 당은 아무도 몰라”)
item.description:
Jang Dong-hyuk heads to Gwangju after Incheon and Busan… Kwon Young-se “No one in our party knows what he’s doing” (인천·부산 이어 광주로 간 장동혁…권영세 “뭐하는지 우리 당은 아무도 몰라”)

People Power Party (PPP) leader Jang Dong-hyuk attended a rally on the evening of the 15th in front of the Gwangju Election Commission in South Jeolla Province, protesting the shortage of ballot papers in the June 3 local elections. This marked his third local rally schedule, following visits to Incheon and Busan. Chairman Jang is also attending a rally at Olympic Park in Songpa-gu, Seoul, in a personal capacity. Within the party, there are reactions saying, “While we must protect voting rights through a special counsel investigation into the Election Commission, it’s hard to understand continuing personal schedules like this outside the National Assembly rather than inside it.” <<> At the rally that day, Chairman Jang stated, “I am willing to stake my political life on protecting the precious vote of the people.” He added, “I hope we can gather at Olympic Park on July 17 (Constitution Day) and show together how hot our anger is and how great our patriotism is,” in the sense of making it a day to restore constitutional order in South Korea by recovering voting rights. <<> In a Pen & Mike YouTube interview before attending the rally, Chairman Jang also said, “If by Constitution Day, negotiations on forming the (parliamentary) leadership and the special counsel for the Election Commission are not conducted in a way we find acceptable, I will not attend this Constitution Day event,” encouraging participation in the Olympic Park rally. Regarding the issue of reinstating independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon (Busan North Gap) into the party, Jang said, “He remains as someone who prevented martial law and led the impeachment, but to push Choo Kyung-ho (Daegu Mayor) and the PPP into a corner and then suddenly say he wants to rejoin the PPP—what kind of logic is that?” <<> Amid Chairman Jang’s continued outside activities, five-term lawmaker Kwon Young-se (Seoul Yongsan) said, “Regardless of how the leadership system changes later, Chairman Jang needs to resign.” Appearing on CBS Radio, Kwon stated, “If he were thinking about how to change the party, there might be a reason to stay, but he shows no such consideration, is completely fixated on voting rights issues, and only operates outside the party. He should aim for conservative victory, but he promotes personal ambition like ‘I must be the front-runner’ and puts private greed and self-interest ahead, sacrificing the party or conservative forces.” <<> Supreme Council member Jo Kwang-han, a close aide to Chairman Jang, told reporters that day, referring to Kwon Young-se, “Isn’t he the one who brought up the idea of nominating Han Deok-soo during the last presidential election and caused tremendous chaos late at night? He has no right to say such things.” <<> Meanwhile, Chairman Jang attended a ‘June 3 Local Election Evaluation and Analysis Meeting’ hosted by ‘Good Friend (GF),’ a gathering of non-incumbent district party chairpersons, held in Indeokwon, Anyang, Gyeonggi Province on the 12th. Regarding this gathering, some within the party speculated, “Isn’t this a venue for Chairman Jang to boost the chances of his close aide, Supreme Council member Jo Kwang-han, in his bid for Gyeonggi Province party chairperson?” <<> Good Friend is a policy study group involving about 50 non-incumbent district party chairpersons from the PPP. The meeting was reportedly attended by Party Leader’s Chief of Staff, lawmaker Park Joon-tae, Supreme Council member Jo Kwang-han, and about 20 non-incumbent district party chairpersons from the Seoul metropolitan area. <<> Among the attendees were district party chairpersons including Oh Kyung-hoon (Seoul Yangcheon B), Jang Sung-ho (Guro B), Kwon Soon-young (Goyang Gap, Gyeonggi), Shin Young-rak (Hwaseong B), Han Gil-ryong (Paju B), Ahn Ki-young (Yangju), Hong Yoon-oh (Suwon B), Kwak Nae-kyung (Bucheon Gap), Seo Young-seok (Bucheon B), Ko Seok (Yongin C), Lee Joo-hyun (Yongin F), Lee Bong-joon (Suwon Gap), Lee Soo-jung (Suwon D), Park Jae-soon (Suwon F), Yoo Young-doo (Gwangju Gap, Gyeonggi), Jeon Dong-seok (Gwangmyeong B), Park Jong-jin (Incheon Yeonsu Gap), Son Beom-gyu (Namdong Gap), and Park Kyung-ho (Daejeon Daedeok). (국민의힘 장동혁 대표가 15일 저녁 전남광주 선관위 앞에서 열린 6·3 지방선거 투표용지 부족 사태 규탄 집회에 참석했다. 인천, 부산에 이어 세 번째 지방 집회 일정이다. 장 대표는 서울 송파구 올림픽공원에서 열리는 집회에도 개인 자격으로 참석하고 있다. 당내에선 “선관위 특검을 통해 참정권 수호를 관철해야 하지만 국회가 아니라 장외에서 이런 식의 개인 일정을 이어가는 것은 이해할 수 없다”는 반응도 나온다.)

item.title: Lee: "Don't Seat a Young Opposite Sex Next to You at Drinking Parties…It May Seem Trivial, but the World Doesn't See It That Way" (李 “술자리 옆에 젊은 이성 앉히지 마라…사소해 보이지만 세상이 안 그래”)
item.description:
Lee: "Don't Seat a Young Opposite Sex Next to You at Drinking Parties…It May Seem Trivial, but the World Doesn't See It That Way" (李 “술자리 옆에 젊은 이성 앉히지 마라…사소해 보이지만 세상이 안 그래”)

President Lee Jae-myung on the 15th urged public officials, "It's fine to drink and have fun, but don't seat a young member of the opposite sex next to you." He emphasized that special caution must be taken regarding sexual misconduct in the workplace. (이재명 대통령 15일 공직자들을 향해 “술 먹고 노는 거 다 좋은데, 옆자리에 젊은 이성을 앉히지 말라“고 당부했다. 직장내 성 비위에 각별한 주의를 기울여야 한다는 것이다.)

During his closing remarks at the second live-streamed work report held at the Blue House that day, the President said, "I wish all public officials in South Korea could hear this," adding, "Young female employees are not playthings, are they?" This comes after a government coordination office investigation revealed that a female firefighter from the Gwangju Gwangsan Fire Station, who died last October, had suffered from frequent forced attendance at drinking parties and workplace harassment. (이 대통령은 이날 청와대에서 열린 2차 생중계 업무보고 마무리 발언에서 “대한민국 모든 공직자가 다 들으면 좋겠다”며 “젊은 이성 직원이 노리개감이 아니지 않느냐”고 말했다. 앞서 지난해 10월 숨진 광주광산소방서 소속 여성 소방관이 직장에서 잦은 술자리 참석 강요와 직장 내 괴롭힘에 시달렸다는 사실이 국무조정실 조사 결과 밝혀진 바 있다.)

The President stated, "Being treated that way is an extremely infuriating situation," and added, "In the past, people tolerated and accepted it. But now, that attitude and mindset itself are a form of personal insult." He continued, "Doesn't that treatment fail to regard them as equal individuals with dignity?" and stressed, "That way of thinking—treating them as objects or means—must no longer exist." (이 대통령은 “그렇게 취급을 당하는 자체가 엄청나게 격분할 상황”이라며 “전에는 다 수용하고 감수했다. 그런데 (이제는) 그런 태도, 그런 마인드 자체가 인격 모독”이라고 했다. 이어 “(그런 취급이) 동등한 인격적 주체로 대하는 것은 아니지 않느냐”면서 “대상으로, 수단으로 (여기는 것이다) 그 생각 자체가 이제는 없어야 된다”고 했다.)

He remarked, "It seems a similar incident occurred not long ago, which is why I'm bringing this up," and added, "In the past, it wasn't a problem, but these days, it's not acceptable. These days, it leads to big trouble." He also said, "One might think it's trivial, but the world doesn't see it that way. It is a brutally serious issue." <<>> (그는 “얼마 전에도 그런 사고가 좀 난 것 같아서 제가 드린 말씀”이라며 “옛날에는 아무 문제가 없었는데, 요즘은 안 된다. 요즘은 큰일 난다”고 했다. “본인은 사소해 보이지만 세상은 안 그렇다. 아주 잔인할 정도로 심각한 문제”라고도 했다.)

item.title: Lee: “Kim Yong’s Ruling Hard to Understand” ... Inside Party: “A Message to Vote for Him” (李 “김용 판결 이해 어렵다”... 당내 “표 주라는 메시지”)
item.description:
Lee: “Kim Yong’s Ruling Hard to Understand” ... Inside Party: “A Message to Vote for Him” (李 “김용 판결 이해 어렵다”... 당내 “표 주라는 메시지”)

President Lee Jae-myung on the 15th referred to the bribery case involving Kim Yong, former deputy director of the Democratic Party Research Institute who ran for the party’s Supreme Council, and said of the court ruling that found the former deputy director guilty, “It is truly hard to understand.” President Lee had previously remarked about Kim Yong, “He should be at least on the level of Kim Yong to be considered a close associate.” Within the party, there were reactions such as, “Isn’t the President effectively signaling support for the former deputy director in the Supreme Council election?” (이재명 대통령은 15일 더불어민주당 최고위원에 출마한 김용 전 민주연구원 부원장의 뇌물 수수 혐의 사건을 언급하면서, 김 전 부원장에게 유죄를 선고한 법원 판결에 대해 “참으로 이해하기 어렵다”고 했다. 이 대통령은 과거 김 전 부원장에 대해 “김용 정도는 돼야 측근”이라고 했었다. 당내에서는 “대통령이 최고위원 선거에서 사실상 김 전 부원장을 지지해 달라는 신호를 보낸 것 아니냐”는 반응이 나왔다.)

President Lee shared a post by Democratic Party lawmaker Lee Geon-tae on X (formerly Twitter) that afternoon, criticizing the court ruling against former deputy director Kim. Earlier, Kim was found guilty of receiving 670 million won in illegal political funds and bribes from private developers in the Daejang-dong case, receiving a five-year prison sentence and a 70 million won fine in both the first and second trials, with a Supreme Court ruling pending. Kim’s side argued that ‘Google Timeline,’ which records location information, showed he was not at the location where prosecutors claimed the money was received, but the court did not accept this. <<> In his post on X that day, Lawmaker Lee argued that prosecutors intentionally ignored Google Timeline while investigating and indicting Kim. He claimed that prosecutors actively used Google Timeline as evidence in other cases but did not do so in Kim’s case, calling it a “double standard by the prosecution.” <<> Citing Lee’s post, President Lee said, “It is truly hard to understand how Google Timeline, which has been used in court as evidence of guilt, is only in certain cases deemed insufficient as evidence of innocence, leading to the bizarre conclusion that even though Google Timeline proves an alibi, the accused is still indicted and convicted.” This indicated his agreement with the lawmaker’s argument. <<> President Lee’s post on X drew reactions within the Democratic Party such as, “This is a message from President Lee to party members to cast votes for former deputy director Kim.” Since Kim is expected to be incarcerated if the Supreme Court confirms his conviction, even among Democratic Party supporters, there have been questions like, “Is it right to vote for him?” Some also questioned whether it was problematic for the President to post what seemed like a message supporting Kim, a pro-Lee candidate, during the party convention, which is unfolding as a pro-Lee vs. pro-Chung conflict. (이 대통령은 이날 오후 X(옛 트위터)에 김 전 부원장의 법원 판결을 비판한 이건태 민주당 의원의 글을 공유했다. 앞서 김 전 부원장은 대장동 민간 업자들로부터 불법 정치자금과 뇌물 6억7000만원을 받은 혐의가 인정돼 1·2심에서 징역 5년과 벌금 7000만원을 선고받고, 대법원 판결을 앞두고 있다. 김 전 부원장 측은 위치 정보가 기록된 ‘구글 타임라인’을 근거로 검찰이 돈을 받았다고 지목한 장소에 있지 않았다고 주장했지만 법원에서 받아들여지지 않았다.)

item.title: Democratic Party Leadership Steps Back… Han Byeong-do: "Will Go Through Sufficient Deliberation" (한발 물러선 與지도부… 한병도 “충분한 숙의 거칠 것”)
item.description:
Democratic Party Leadership Steps Back… Han Byeong-do: "Will Go Through Sufficient Deliberation" (한발 물러선 與지도부… 한병도 “충분한 숙의 거칠 것”)

Within the Democratic Party of Korea, the argument that the prosecution's supplementary investigation authority should be partially retained is growing louder. The party leadership also appears to have stepped back, stating, "We will go through a sufficient deliberation process." (더불어민주당에서 검찰 보완수사권을 일부 남겨야 한다는 주장이 더 커지고 있다. 당 지도부도 “충분한 숙의 과정을 거치겠다”며 한발 물러선 모양새다.)

Acting Party Leader and Floor Leader Han Byeong-do said at the party's supreme council meeting that day, "We will continue deliberation while gathering opinions from the legal community, academia, and civil society," adding, "We will catch both rabbits—deliberation and timely legislation." This comes after 10 out of 15 lawmakers who spoke at the general meeting of lawmakers the previous day expressed concerns over complete abolition, indicating that the deliberation process for the revision of the Criminal Procedure Act to abolish the supplementary investigation authority will be further extended. A party official said, "The goal was to pass it in the plenary session of the National Assembly before the August 17 party convention, but there could be further discussions on the timing." <<> Five-term lawmaker Park Ji-won, who had until recently insisted on the complete abolition of the supplementary investigation authority, also changed his stance. Park had previously said to moderates within the party, "Are you not going to make jang (soybean paste) because you're afraid of maggots?" but on this day, he appeared on the radio and said, "It's not our opinion that matters, but the people's thoughts." He added, "For crimes against the socially disadvantaged, such as youth, women, and the disabled, it is right to have the supplementary investigation authority." <<> Lawmaker Lee So-young, who co-sponsored lawmaker Hong Gi-won's bill to partially retain the supplementary investigation authority, said in a CBS radio interview targeting hardliners, "If you can't clearly explain why the complete abolition of the supplementary investigation authority is the completion of prosecution reform, that's incitement." She also argued, "Unrelated investigations, targeted investigations, and covering up cases involving those in power are not related to granting the supplementary investigation authority," adding, "Unrelated and targeted investigations are already not possible, and covering up cases for the powerful—if a case comes to the prosecution with insufficient evidence—abolishing the supplementary investigation authority would actually create a better environment for dropping charges by blaming the police." <<> Lawmaker Kim Nam-hee, who also co-sponsored the bill, said on SBS radio, criticizing hardliners, "They talk about the abolition of the supplementary investigation authority as if it's an absolute truth and use it as a tool to appeal to hardline party members," calling it "a highly inappropriate act for a politician." <<> The presidential office has not yet stated a clear position on the supplementary investigation authority issue, where disagreements within the ruling party are erupting. Until now, President Yoon had called for partially retaining the supplementary investigation authority or preparing proper supplementary measures. However, amid recent backlash from hardline supporters, he reportedly said, "The National Assembly must decide and also take responsibility." A Democratic Party lawmaker commented, "Aren't the lawmakers who co-sponsored the retention bill mostly pro-Moon?" adding, "The content of the bill also resembles the government's original plan, which mirrored the president's thinking." (한병도 당대표 직무대행 겸 원내대표는 이날 당 최고위에서 “법조계와 학계, 시민사회의 의견을 수렴하면서 숙의를 이어가겠다”며 “숙의와 적기 입법이라는 두 마리 토끼를 모두 잡겠다”고 했다. 전날 의원총회에서 발언한 15명 가운데 10명이 완전 폐지를 우려하는 의견을 내자, 보완수사권 폐지를 위한 형사소송법 개정안에 대한 숙의 과정을 더 거치겠다는 것이다. 민주당 관계자는 “8·17 전당대회 전 국회 본회의 처리가 목표였지만, 시점에 대한 재논의도 있을 수 있다”고 했다.)

item.title: "If You Let Them Off, You'll Be Screwed": The Deep-Rooted Distrust of the Prosecution Among the Hardline Faction of the Ruling Party (“봐주면 당한다” 與강경파의 뿌리 깊은 검찰 불신)
item.description:
"If You Let Them Off, You'll Be Screwed": The Deep-Rooted Distrust of the Prosecution Among the Hardline Faction of the Ruling Party (“봐주면 당한다” 與강경파의 뿌리 깊은 검찰 불신)

On the 15th, hardliners from the Democratic Party of Korea directed harsh criticism at party lawmakers who opposed the complete abolition of supplementary investigative powers, saying, "Why are you arbitrarily overturning the party line?" and "You are committing a grave sin before history." They emphasized that now is the time to achieve what was left unfinished during the Moon Jae-in administration—the so-called "complete stripping of prosecution investigative powers." (더불어민주당 강경파는 15일 당내 보완수사권 완전 폐지 반대 목소리를 내는 의원들을 향해 “왜 마음대로 당론을 뒤집냐” “역사 앞에 큰 죄를 짓는 것”이라고 했다. 이들은 이번에야말로 문재인 정부 때 이루지 못했던 이른바 ‘검수완박(검찰 수사권 완전 박탈)’을 해야 할 때라고 강조하고 있다.)

Jeong Cheong-rae, a former party leader who was at the forefront of prosecution reform, wrote on Facebook as calls grew within the Democratic Party to partially retain supplementary investigative powers: "This is really serious. Why has this atmosphere suddenly emerged? I'm depressed." Jeong had repeatedly stated during his tenure as party leader that "abolition is the party line." (검찰 개편 관련 가장 선봉에 섰던 정청래 전 대표는 민주당 내 보완수사권 일부 존치 주장에 커지자 페이스북에 “정말 심각하다. 갑자기 왜 이런 분위기가 됐는지. 우울하다”고 썼다. 정 전 대표는 당대표 시절 ”폐지가 당론”이라고 여러차례 말한 바 있다.)

Pro-Jeong faction Supreme Council member Moon Jeong-bok also said on the same day, "Prosecution reform is a generational task that party members and the people have commanded of the Democratic Party." He added, "If this is shaken or derailed again by conflicting interests and claims within the party, the Democratic Party will bear great responsibility before history." He further argued, "The abolition of supplementary investigative powers is already a clear party line that the Democratic Party has announced to its members and the people." This was in reaction to the party having set the policy of "abolishing supplementary investigative powers while retaining the right to request supplemental investigations" as party line in February, only for some to now claim it "was not the party line." Lawmaker Choi Min-hee also expressed concern, saying, "With a leader who has a strong will for prosecution reform, I'm very worried that various requests that used to fail are now getting through to the Democratic Party." <<> The hardline support base of the ruling party harbors a deep-seated distrust of the prosecution. Their view is that the Roh Moo-hyun and Moon Jae-in administrations were undermined by a politicized prosecution, leading to the failure of those governments. In particular, they assess that the failure to complete the stripping of prosecution investigative powers during the Moon administration led to the 'Cho Kuk incident,' which in turn resulted in the birth of the Yoon Suk Yeol government and even martial law. President Lee Jae-myung is also seen as a victim of fabricated prosecutorial investigations. On the bulletin board of Kim Eo-joon's Ddanji Ilbo, a hub for hardline supporters, posts have poured in saying things like, "If this continues, the prosecution will get us again," "If President Lee Jae-myung joins hands with the prosecution like this, he's unforgivable," and "Lee Jae-myung is a traitor to the democratic camp." (친청(친정청래)계 문정복 최고위원도 이날 “검찰개혁은 당원과 국민이 민주당에 명령한 시대적 과제“라면서 “이를 당내의 엇갈린 이해와 주장으로 다시 흔들거나 좌초시킨다면 민주당은 역사 앞에 큰 책임을 지게 될 것”이라고 했다. 이어 “보완수사권 폐지는 이미 민주당이 당원과 국민 앞에 밝힌 분명한 당론”이라고 했다. 당이 지난 2월 당론으로 ‘보완수사권 폐지, 보완수사요구권 유지’를 정해놓고 이제와서 ”당론이 아니었다“고 했다며 반발한 것이다. 최민희 의원도 “검찰개혁에 강력한 의지를 가진 대표가 있어서 통하지 않던 각종 부탁이 민주당에 통하고 있나 싶어 무척 걱정된다”고 했다.)

item.title: Voices within the Ruling Party Also Spread, Calling for "Retention of Supplementary Investigation Authority" (與서도 “보완수사권 유지” 목소리 확산)
item.description:
Voices within the Ruling Party Also Spread, Calling for "Retention of Supplementary Investigation Authority" (與서도 “보완수사권 유지” 목소리 확산)

Within the Democratic Party of Korea, voices opposing the complete abolition of prosecutors' supplementary investigation authority are growing louder. Some lawmakers are even considering proposing legislation that would allow supplementary investigation authority in cases such as digital sex crimes. (더불어민주당 내에서 검사의 보완수사권 전면 폐지에 반대하는 목소리가 커지고 있다. 일부 의원은 디지털 성범죄 등 사건에 보완수사권을 허용하는 법안을 발의하는 방안도 검토하고 있다.)

Former Minister of Justice Park Beom-kye, speaking at a general meeting of Democratic Party lawmakers on the 14th, reportedly argued that without prosecutors' supplementary investigation authority, gaps could arise in cases where the detention period or statute of limitations is about to expire, or for crimes requiring swift investigation due to the ease of destroying evidence. Three-term lawmaker Maeng Seong-gyu also expressed the opinion that supplementary investigation authority should be exceptionally retained for sex crimes and crimes against children, adolescents, the disabled, and the elderly. Both lawmakers are considering proposing amendments to the Criminal Procedure Act containing such provisions. Previously, 11 Democratic Party lawmakers, including Rep. Hong Gi-won, proposed a revision to the Criminal Procedure Act to retain prosecutors' supplementary investigation authority for crimes against social minorities or for everyday crimes like voice phishing. (법무부 장관을 지낸 박범계 의원은 지난 14일 민주당 의원총회에 참석해 구속기한이나 공소시효 만료가 임박했거나, 증거 삭제가 쉬워 신속한 수사가 필요한 범죄의 경우 검사의 보완수사권이 없을 때 공백이 발생할 수 있다고 주장했다고 한다. 3선인 맹성규 의원도 성폭력 범죄와 아동·청소년·장애인·노인 대상 범죄는 예외적으로 보완수사권을 유지하자는 의견을 냈다. 두 의원은 이런 내용을 담은 형사소송법 개정안을 발의하는 방안도 검토하고 있다. 앞서 홍기원 의원 등 민주당 의원 11명은 사회적 약자를 대상으로 하거나, 보이스피싱 등 민생 범죄에 대해서는 검사의 보완수사권을 유지하도록 하는 내용의 형소법 개정안을 발의했다.)

Their claims differ from the Democratic Party's task force (TF) proposal for amending the Criminal Procedure Act, which would completely abolish the supplementary investigation authority and only grant the authority to request supplementary investigations. Minister of Justice Jeong Seong-ho stated at the National Assembly's Legislation and Judiciary Committee that day, "If we assume abolition of supplementary investigation, we must ensure there are no victims among the 1% who might suffer unfairly." (이들의 주장은 검사의 보완수사권을 완전 폐지하고 보완수사 요구권만 부여하는 민주당 형소법 개정 태스크포스(TF) 안과는 차이가 있다. 정성호 법무부 장관은 이날 국회 법제사법위원회에서 “보완수사 폐지를 전제로 한다고 하면 억울한 1%의 피해자가 없도록 해야 한다“고 했다.)

Following lawyers' groups and women's organizations, victims of violent crimes also opposed the complete abolition of supplementary investigation authority. Victims of incidents such as the "Busan roundhouse kick case" held a press conference at the Seoul Seocho-gu Bar Association building that day, arguing, "The current prosecution reform is being carried out with victims excluded," and insisting that "victim protection measures must be established first." (변호사 단체, 여성단체에 이어 강력범죄 피해자들도 보완수사권 전면 폐지에 반대했다. ‘부산 돌려차기 사건’ 등 피해자들은 이날 서울 서초구 변호사회관에서 기자회견을 열고 “지금의 검찰개혁은 피해자가 배제된 채 이뤄지고 있다”며 “피해자 보호 장치를 먼저 마련해야 한다”고 주장했다.)

Within the Democratic Party, the possibility of delaying the handling of the Criminal Procedure Act is also being discussed. The party initially aimed to finalize the revision of the Criminal Procedure Act before the August 17 party convention, which will elect the next party leader. A lawmaker from the party's leadership said, "We need to fully heed the opinions that supplementary investigation authority should be exceptionally retained," adding, "Although it's difficult to fix a timeline for processing, we are also keeping in mind the possibility that discussions may continue after the party convention." (민주당 내부에서는 형소법 처리 시점이 늦춰질 가능성도 거론된다. 민주당은 애초 차기 당대표를 뽑는 8·17 전당대회 이전에 형소법 개정을 마무리하겠다는 입장이었다. 민주당 지도부의 한 의원은 “예외적으로 보완수사권을 존치해야 한다는 의견을 충분히 들을 필요가 있다”며 “처리 시점을 못 박기는 어렵지만 전당대회 이후로 논의가 이어질 가능성도 염두에 두고 있다”고 했다.)
